title: Ruby D Charters
specs: 29 foot North River boat with twin 300 HP motors
Captain Dale and Aaron are Coast Guard Licensed
includes: Refreshments (bottled water and other cold drinks)
12 v and 110 v Power Plugs for charging your electronics
blurb: Guests can book private fishing charters on a 29 foot North River boat with twin 300 HP motors. Activities include fishing, crabbing, burial at sea, sightseeing, and private rentals for special occasions. Special pick-ups can be arranged at Shilshole Bay Marina, Seattle or Kingston Marina, Kingston, and South Whidbey Island for additional fees.
extraNote: All charters are private · Special pick-ups at Shilshole Bay Marina, Seattle or Kingston Marina, Kingston for an additional $150 fee and South Whidbey Island for $200 · Departs – Port of Edmonds, WA

quotes.text: I can’t appreciate captain Dale enough what he had done for us for the entire 6 hr fishing and this experience is too good to keep it for myself - I usually do not leave any review unless I am extremely amazed. My experience with captain Dale was beyond amazing and I highly recommend to ANYONE with confidence. Are you so sick of work/daily routine? Wanna do something different? Hey, pack your bag and call Captain Dale. My hubby and I are already planning to have another fishing session with captain Dale near future. Thanks again! Until next time captain Dale, cheers!!!

I've been a charter boat captain for 15 years in Alaska & know the business very well. I've been fishing with Captain Dale for over 20 years in Seattle and in Alaska as well. Dale is a great guy to go fishing with. We always have a great time. He works hard. He's real sharp & he is very entertaining. He has a real good feel for finding where the fish are & staying on top of them. He has a good network with other captains in the area so when fishing is slow he can relocate. You can't go wrong fishing with Captain Dale. Good luck - Captain Jason Heck

Dale was such an amazing captain! My mother, boyfriend and myself went out with Dale on 3/17/16 and had a blast! Not only did we catch some delicious fish, but we were able to witness whales due to Dales wonderful eye AND a seal that stole a fish right off our line! I would recommend going out with Dale and I know we will definitely be back out to take this trip again with him! Thank you Dale for an amazing time!

Dale is a great captain and his boat and gear are top-notch. He’s knowledgable and knows his fishing. He’s also just a really great guy; really enjoyable to be around and you can tell that he loves what he does. I would highly recommend him to any of my friends and family.

We had a great time and that’s all Tiffani and Damen have talked about. I think we’re already planning on coming back in July for King salmon. We will definitely book with you guys again. Again, thank you for a great experience.
Went out for Silvers with Captain Dale who put us on fish all day long. Great captain and awesome boat. I will be back out on the water with him again very soon.
